tasks.task: Write or rewrite an Amazon listing

items.when: Before writing, to pick which phrases go in the title, the bullets and the backend
When rivals crowd the page, to find their weak spots and your best selling points
When you have the product's real facts and the words shoppers use
When you want a fast second draft of title and bullets to compare against the first
When keywords are sorted into tiers, to see a version that leads with benefits
When the bullets are vague praise, to replace each with a fact a shopper can check
Before publishing a new or edited listing, to catch what Amazon would flag

tasks.task: Check a listing against Amazon's rules or fix a flagged one

items.when: When a listing is flagged or suppressed, or before any edit goes live
When the copy makes health, safety or best-in-class claims that need proof
When you hold the proof, to pair each claim with it and see the gaps

tasks.task: Mine reviews for complaints, wants and buyer words

items.when: When researching a niche, improving a product or writing a listing from reviews
When you want reviews split by star rating to see what each group says
When you need complaints, praise and requests ranked by how often they come up
When you want the reasons people bought, each in a customer's exact words
Before trusting a rival's reviews, to rate them for signs of fake or bought ones

tasks.task: Judge whether a niche or product idea is worth selling

items.when: When a client asks if a product idea or niche is worth it on Amazon
When the client has a category but no idea, to find searches page one does not serve
When you want ideas from buyer problems, not from keywords, to compare both routes
When the client pays for a data service and you need rank, review and seller numbers
When an idea looks good, to check how many sellers and how strong they are
When a research tool shows a big sales number, to ask what it really measures

tasks.task: Rank several product ideas on one scorecard

items.when: When each idea has costs, to score it out of 100 and name its weakest test
When you want ideas found and one scored to a go, test first or no-go
When the list is thin, to add ideas that come from what buyers complain about
Before stock is ordered, to score the four risks and find the cheapest first test
When an idea scores well on paper, to plan a small paid test before a full order

tasks.task: Work out unit profit, fees and break-even ACOS

items.when: Before the profit sum, to get cost per sellable unit from the quote and freight
Before ordering stock or setting an ad budget, or when sales are good but cash is not
When you want every Amazon fee listed by size tier and the margin scored
When you need a quick second sum of profit per unit and break-even ad cost
When one shipment carried several products and freight and duty must be split
When the margin only works if nothing goes wrong, to ask how much room for error is left

tasks.task: Write a trend brief or monthly scan of new ideas

items.when: When a trend must be judged real or not, with its stage, risks and next steps
When you need a cited read of what people have said about a topic lately
When you want the pain points and buying signals people post, with links
Before the client acts, to make a fad or lasting-shift call on each item

tasks.task: Build a 90-day Amazon launch plan for one product

items.when: Before the plan, to fix the margin and the ad cost the product can carry
When one product needs a 90-day plan built from its real margin and budget
When listing, launch ads, stock and launch week must be planned in one run
When you need the days before and after go-live planned for early sales and reviews
When the launch needs its first auto, keyword and competitor campaigns with bids
When the plan is built around the seller's hopes, to restart from what the customer needs
Before the 90 days are fixed, to compare two plans that split the launch budget and the weeks differently

tasks.task: Take a new product from idea to launch

items.when: When a client wants to sell a new product, or choose between ideas, before ordering stock
At the start, to decide whether the idea is worth the next step
When the idea passes and the product must be specified, made and inspected
When stock is on order and the first 90 days need planning

tasks.task: Run the monthly Amazon account check

items.when: In the first week after the month closes, to run the review in order
When the client has exported the month's reports and wants the account checked
When margins, restock and refund claims should be checked from the same reports
When sales or conversion fell, to confirm the change and rank what drove it
Before reading any report, to catch gaps, duplicates and odd values in the export
Before the review goes to the client, to check the method and the sums

tasks.task: Review the search term report

items.when: Weekly in a launch and monthly after, to find searches that pay and searches that waste
When you want a second sort into winners, negatives and a waste score
When winning searches should be moved into the title, bullets or backend

tasks.task: Claim back lost, damaged or missing FBA stock

items.when: When you have shipment and fee reports, to find which claims are worth filing
When stock is lost, damaged or short on an inbound shipment and Amazon has not paid
When you want the shipment planned so that any later claim has its proof ready
Before filing, to check the shipment and receipt records for gaps and duplicates

tasks.task: Plan inbound shipments and restock dates

items.when: When you know sales, lead times and case sizes and need how much to send and when
When there is sales history, to forecast demand and set safety stock first
When you want reorder points and an ABC ranking to test the plan against
Each week, to see what to reorder and whether cash can cover it
When several shipments are moving and need one shared tracker

tasks.task: Request supplier quotes and approve samples

items.when: When buyer complaints should shape the spec, to write a quote request in maker terms
When quotes are back, to set price, minimum order, lead time and risk side by side
When samples arrive, to get go or hold and the fixes to send the factory
Before the final payment, to brief an inspector with a pass rule

tasks.task: Set prices, repricing rules and promotions

items.when: When you have costs and rival offers and need a price and rules for rival discounts
When the right price is unclear, to plan a test with three outcomes you can undo
When prices will move by rule and need floors, test cases and a kill switch
When coupons or deals are planned, to size the lift, the cost and the extra stock
Before any price or deal goes live, to check the unit still makes money

tasks.task: Set up brand registry and deal with hijackers

items.when: When the brand is not registered, to choose a trademark route and the tools to turn on
When another seller is on the listing or fakes appear, to check and draft complaints
Each month, to see lost buy box share or new sellers on your listings early

tasks.task: Plan the listing's image set and main image test

items.when: When you have photos and facts and need an eight-image plan with a gaps list
When the image is seen as a small thumbnail, to score what reads in three seconds

tasks.task: Tear down rival listings to find your edge

items.when: When you have rival listings and reviews and need their weak spots ranked
Before the teardown, to pull what buyers dislike about each rival
When price and features must be set against yours with gaps to act on
When the product is crowded, to find buyer groups the rivals do not serve

tasks.task: Get more reviews within the rules and cut returns

items.when: When reviews are few, to plan when and how to ask and how to answer a bad one
Each month, to find the products driving refunds, why and what it costs
When returns rise, to see whether reviews name the same fault
Before any insert or message asks for a review, to check it against Amazon's rules

tasks.task: Plan a move into another Amazon country

items.when: When the client wants to sell abroad and needs countries ranked with shipping and tax costs
When margin per product and compliance to-dos are needed for each marketplace
Before stock ships across a border, to list the rules that apply and who owns each
When fees and freight differ by country, to redo the unit sum for each one

always.when: When a listing or report states a number or claim you cannot trace to the client
Before any workings go to the client, to catch formula errors and broken links

helpers.when: When ads need a full structure, weekly search term work and bid rules
When the listing needs a new image set shot or specified for Amazon
When many listings or A+ pages need writing in one brand voice
When stock planning spans several suppliers, long lead times or more than one warehouse
When review complaints call for a changed product, not a changed listing
When Amazon payouts must be matched to the books and fees split out

gaps: No library item writes A+ content, a brand story or an Amazon storefront plan
No library item handles account health: policy warnings, a suppressed listing or a suspension appeal and plan of action
No library item sets up variations: parent and child listings, and when to split or merge them
No library item matches Amazon settlement reports to payouts and fees line by line
No library item covers product compliance for Amazon: safety documents, labels and restricted categories
No library item plans Amazon coupons, Lightning Deals, Prime Day or Subscribe and Save offers by name
No library item answers customer questions on a listing or plans the question and answer section
No library item covers Walmart, eBay or other marketplaces when the client asks to copy a listing across
No library item tracks keyword rank and buy box share week by week
No English library item checks photos against Amazon's image rules or plans main image test versions; the two that exist are written in Chinese
